title: 第一卷第23章 天阶功法第一卷第24章 前往王都再入蛮荒之森
content_zh:
“什……什么？”
或许是不敢相信，又或许是没听太清，李总管突然变得结结巴巴。
“我说，功法我有。”
顾寒又重复了一遍。
腾地一下！
七皇子瞬间站了起来，激动得身体颤抖不停。
“那你……”
一旁，李总管面色陡然间涨得通红。
“你能给……”
看到他这副表情，顾寒下意识松了口气。
他知道自己赌赢了，虽然李总管说话尖酸刻薄，又有那么点仗势欺人的意思，可本质上并不坏，否则绝不会是这个反应了。
“咱家明白了！”
见顾寒不说话。
李总管一咬牙，大袖一扫，将七皇子身边的几颗兽核卷起，直接吞了下去！
刹那间。
他脸色便苍白了下来。
他功法偏向阴柔，这兽核中火意旺盛，贸然吞食，对身体自然有不小的负担。
“李总管。”
七皇子叹了口气。
“你没必要……唉！”

“殿下，不必多说了。”
李总管看着顾寒，“当年咱家让人欺辱得像条狗一样，若是没有皇妃搭救，不可能会有咱家的今天！七皇子是皇妃唯一的骨血，只要能救他，别说吞了兽核，你就是要咱家跪下，要咱家的命，咱家都绝无二话！”
说着。
他双膝一软，竟是要跪下来！
薛神医不忍再看。
只是功法是顾寒的，他自认为没有说话的资格，自然不好劝说。
“我其实想说。”
顾寒头疼不已，连忙拦住了他。
“你就算不吃兽核，这功法我也会拿出来的。”
“你……”
李总管表情一僵。
“你怎么不早说？”
“没来得及。”
“……”
想到刚刚自己的窘态。
李总管想死。
“哈哈哈……”
content_en:
"Wha...what?"
Perhaps because he couldn't believe it, or perhaps because he didn't hear clearly, Manager Li suddenly became stammering.
"I said, I have the technique."
Gu Han repeated it again.
Make some space!
The seventh prince stood up instantly, his body shaking with excitement.
"Then you..."
On the side, Manager Li's face suddenly turned red.
"Can you give..."
Seeing his expression, Gu Han subconsciously breathed a sigh of relief.
He knew that he had won the bet. Although Manager Li was sarcastic and a bit bullying, he was not inherently bad, otherwise he would never have reacted this way.
"Our family understands!"
Gu Han didn't say anything.
Manager Li gritted his teeth, swept his sleeves, rolled up a few beast cores around the seventh prince, and swallowed them directly!
In an instant.
His face turned pale.
His martial arts tend to be feminine, and the fire in this beast's core is strong. If he swallows it hastily, it will naturally be a big burden on the body.
"Manager Li."
The seventh prince sighed.
"You don't have to... ugh!"
"Your Highness, there is no need to say more."
Manager Li looked at Gu Han, "Back then, our family was bullied like a dog. If it hadn't been for the imperial concubine's rescue, our family would not be where we are today! The seventh prince is the only flesh and blood of the imperial concubine. As long as we can save him, let alone swallowing the beast's core, you will kneel down and kill our family, and our family will not hesitate!"
Said.
His knees weakened and he was about to kneel down!
Doctor Xue couldn't bear to look any further.
It's just that the technique belongs to Gu Han. He doesn't think he's qualified to speak, so it's naturally difficult to persuade him.
"I actually wanted to say that."
Gu Han had a headache and quickly stopped him.
"Even if you don't eat the animal core, I will still use this technique."
"You..."
Manager Li's expression froze.
"Why didn't you tell me earlier?"
"Not in time."
"..."
Thinking of my embarrassment just now.
Manager Li wants to die.
"Hahaha……"
